meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在处理附带的办公文档(Word、PPT、Excel、文本型 PDF 等)时,会在本地容器内把它们转成 Markdown 再阅读或总结,不会把文件上传到外部解析服务。
howto.when: 当发送或要求处理附带的 Word、PPT、Excel、文本型 PDF 等办公文档,需要读取其内容时触发;转换全程在容器本地完成,不上传文件。

say.text: 把附件里的 Word 文档转成 Markdown,提取关键信息。
say.note: Claude 会本地转换再总结。

say.text: 这个 Excel 附件有几张表?分析一下数据。
say.note: 会先转成 Markdown 表格再回答。

say.text: 这个 PDF 是扫描件,能提取文字吗?
say.note: 纯图片 PDF 会明确失败,不会被上传。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude converts attached office documents (Word, PPT, Excel, text-based PDFs, etc.) to Markdown locally inside the container and then reads or summarizes them, without uploading files to a hosted parser.
howto.when_en: Triggered when an agent needs to read attached office documents such as Word, PPT, Excel, or text-based PDFs, and the conversion is meant to stay local instead of using a cloud parser.

say_en.text: Convert the Word attachment to Markdown and extract key info.
How many sheets in this Excel attachment? Analyze the data.
say_en.note: It will turn sheets into Markdown tables first.

say_en.text: This PDF is a scan—can you extract the text?
say_en.note: Image-only PDFs fail clearly and are not uploaded.
